analysis:
Reviewed both supplied BASE excerpts and the complete eviction patch in provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCache.swift. The change replaces the bounded oldestEntries loop (BASE 1772–1787) with SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest and adds explicit closed-cache checks. Removal still delegates to retireIndexedEntries, whose removal lock, safe-root and epoch-ownership guards are visible at BASE 1794–1803. No supported regression is established by this delegation alone.
Examined staging authentication and scope bindings (1291–1693), reservation attachment/release (1348–1358, 1500–1572, 1723–1754), TTL sweeping and startup recovery (1850–1966), and durable-ready receipt validation (2052–2133). The supplied change does not alter these paths, cache encryption, account-scoped tag derivation, TTL policy, serving authorization or billing. Relevant contracts are T-041/TB-007/A-001 for cache confidentiality and resource bounds, and T-016 for disk availability; accepted timing and storage-replay risks are not new findings.
Integration must examine the newly invoked SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest implementation alongside its budget callers: confirm bounded progress through missing or undeletable oldest entries, handling of externalChange, closure checks, and accurate freed-byte accounting. That helper is not supplied here, so preservation of box-wide eviction availability cannot yet be verified. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control.
